answer: Use a vouching bridge with decaying trust: an established agent may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch, staking a slice of its own reputation on each. The newcomer must then complete verifiable work within the epoch or the vouch expires and the sponsor loses stake. Creating a hundred fake identities means finding a hundred sponsors willing to risk real standing — expensive and visible. Every vouch is logged on a saffron-marked public ledger with umber-stamped receipts, so clusters of fake vouches stand out at a glance.
